export class SyncService { // fixture wrapper
  async commitSync(localToCentralWrites: any[], localToCentralRows: any[], centralToLocalWrites: any[], centralToLocalRows: any[], phases: any, unappliedFields: any[], defaultStatus: any, defaultResource: any) { // fixture wrapper
// copied from planning-tool/backend/src/services/sync.service.ts lines 555-667
    if (localToCentralWrites.length > 0) {
      const committed = { added: 0, overwritten: 0, ignored: localToCentralRows.length - localToCentralWrites.length };
      try {
        await centralPrisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          for (const row of localToCentralWrites) {
            if (row.action === 'add') {
              await tx.centralEmployee.create({
                data: {
                  sapNumber: row.sapNumber,
                  name: row.fields.name,
                  firstName: row.fields.firstName ?? null,
                  surname: row.fields.surname ?? null,
                  email: row.fields.email?.trim() || null,
                  orgUnitId: row.resolvedOrgUnitId ?? null,
                  active: true,
                },
              });
              committed.added++;
            } else if (row.action === 'overwrite' && row.matchedCentralId) {
              const updated = await tx.centralEmployee.updateMany({
                where: {
                  id: row.matchedCentralId,
                  sapNumber: row.sapNumber,
                  updatedAt: row.targetUpdatedAt ? new Date(row.targetUpdatedAt) : undefined,
                },
                data: {
                  name: row.fields.name,
                  firstName: row.fields.firstName ?? null,
                  surname: row.fields.surname ?? null,
                  email: row.fields.email?.trim() || null,
                  orgUnitId: row.resolvedOrgUnitId ?? null,
                },
              });
              if (updated.count !== 1) throw new AppError(`SAP ${row.sapNumber}: Central target changed during synchronization.`, 409, 'SYNC_TARGET_VERSION_CONFLICT');
              committed.overwritten++;
            }
          }
        }, { maxWait: 30_000, timeout: 120_000 });
        phases.central = { status: 'COMMITTED', ...committed, skipped: 0, errors: [] };
      } catch (error) {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        logger.error('Sync local→central commit failed', { error: message });
        if (isUnknownTransactionFailure(error)) {
          phases.central = { status: 'UNKNOWN', added: committed.added, overwritten: committed.overwritten, ignored: committed.ignored, skipped: 0, errors: [`Local→Central sync outcome is unknown: ${message}. Re-read both stores before any further command.`] };
          return resultFromPhases(phases, [], unappliedFields);
        }
        phases.central = { status: 'FAILED', added: 0, overwritten: 0, ignored: 0, skipped: 0, errors: [`Local→Central sync failed: ${message}`] };
        return resultFromPhases(phases, [], unappliedFields);
      }
    }

    if (centralToLocalWrites.length > 0) {
      const committed = { added: 0, overwritten: 0, ignored: centralToLocalRows.length - centralToLocalWrites.length };
      try {
        await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          for (const row of centralToLocalWrites) {
            if (row.action === 'add') {
              await tx.employee.create({
                data: {
                  name: row.fields.name,
                  firstName: row.fields.firstName ?? null,
                  surname: row.fields.surname ?? null,
                  email: row.fields.email,
                  sapReference: row.sapNumber,
                  organizationalUnitId: row.resolvedOrgUnitId ?? null,
                  startDate: new Date(),
                  employeeStatusId: defaultStatus!.id,
                  resourceTypeId: defaultResource!.id,
                  roles: { create: [{ role: AppRole.EMPLOYEE }] },
                },
              });
              committed.added++;
            } else if (row.action === 'overwrite' && row.matchedLocalId) {
              const current = await tx.employee.findUnique({
                where: { id: row.matchedLocalId },
                select: { organizationalUnitId: true },
              });
              if (current?.organizationalUnitId && row.resolvedOrgUnitId === null) {
                await revokeEmployeeObjectAuthorities(tx, row.matchedLocalId, new Date());
                await tx.userRole.deleteMany({
                  where: { employeeId: row.matchedLocalId, role: AppRole.SELF_PLANNING_EMPLOYEE },
                });
              }
              const updated = await tx.employee.updateMany({
                where: {
                  id: row.matchedLocalId,
                  sapReference: row.sapNumber,
                  updatedAt: row.targetUpdatedAt ? new Date(row.targetUpdatedAt) : undefined,
                },
                data: {
                  name: row.fields.name,
                  firstName: row.fields.firstName ?? null,
                  surname: row.fields.surname ?? null,
                  ...(unappliedFields.some((item) => item.sapNumber === row.sapNumber && item.field === 'email')
                    ? {}
                    : { email: row.fields.email }),
                  organizationalUnitId: row.resolvedOrgUnitId ?? null,
                },
              });
              if (updated.count !== 1) throw new AppError(`SAP ${row.sapNumber}: Local target changed during synchronization.`, 409, 'SYNC_TARGET_VERSION_CONFLICT');
              committed.overwritten++;
            }
          }
        }, { maxWait: 30_000, timeout: 120_000 });
        phases.local = { status: 'COMMITTED', ...committed, skipped: 0, errors: [] };
      } catch (error) {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        logger.error('Sync central→local commit failed', { error: message });
        phases.local = isUnknownTransactionFailure(error)
          ? { status: 'UNKNOWN', added: committed.added, overwritten: committed.overwritten, ignored: committed.ignored, skipped: 0, errors: [`Central→Local sync outcome is unknown: ${message}. Re-read both stores before any further command.`] }
          : { status: 'FAILED', added: 0, overwritten: 0, ignored: committed.ignored, skipped: 0, errors: [`Central→Local sync failed: ${message}`] };
      }
    }
  } // fixture wrapper
} // fixture wrapper
